title: One & in an operator-supplied cover URL would make the whole sitemap ill-formed XML

source.ref: found 2026-10-05 by the scan-seven seo-sitemap finder and its skeptic; confirmed against node_modules/next/dist/build/webpack/loaders/metadata/resolve-route-data.js

detail: FOUND 2026-10-05 (scan seven). Next's sitemap serializer writes <loc> and <image:loc> verbatim (resolve-route-data.js lines 112 and 123, no escaping), and app/sitemap.ts hands it Space covers, event covers and product images that operators and the importer supply. A single & in one of those URLs (a CDN query string is enough) makes the whole file ill-formed XML, and a parser that rejects the file loses every URL in it, not one. Our own route URLs carry no reserved characters. CLOSED 2026-10-05: the sitemap's one return passes through xmlSafe, which escapes &, <, >, double and single quotes in url and images; app/sitemap.test.ts pins a product image with a query string.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const s=require("fs").readFileSync("app/sitemap.ts","utf8");if(!/return xmlSafe\(/.test(s)||!/images\.map\(escapeXml\)/.test(s)){console.error("SCAN-785: the sitemap hands image URLs to Next unescaped, and Next writes <image:loc> verbatim, so one & in an operator-supplied cover makes the whole sitemap ill-formed XML and every URL in it unreadable.");process.exit(1)}'
verify.note: Fails on main before this change; passes with it.
